title: Those Who Do Not Meditate
summary: Patience is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Those who do not meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are murderers of the soul; it is only obtained by great good fortune
lifeApplication: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
